data.name: Ghufrah
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'ghafara' which means 'to hide, conceal, or cover'. In Islamic tradition, Ghufrah represents the inner beauty, grace, and radiance that can only be revealed through the veil of modesty and humility. The name Ghufrah is a reminder to cherish and protect this hidden treasure, as it is a reflection of the beauty and wisdom granted by Allah.
